summary: So many residents come that the meeting is moved to a larger hall and only some get to speak.
realLife: A town council hearing was moved from town hall to a church auditorium for at least 500 people; about 30 spoke and the vote was put off to the next meeting.
sources: WSOC-TV, hundreds at Weddington town hearing: https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/development-debate-brings-hundreds-raucous-weddington-town-meeting/BATFRWXP6NCZFBC2CEMHZBD7IY
inGame: a posted meeting of the town's body with a crowd-size attendance count; needs: a venue-change and speaker-limit record on the meeting

turns.summary: The usual room is big enough and everyone who wants to speaks.

turns.summary: The body votes the same night despite the crowd.
